AI Video Creator Online — Initial Release

- Create and export 1080p MP4 videos from images or text online in 1–2 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG files up to 500MB.
- Automatic setup, with free anonymous token granting 100 credits for 7 days.
- Simple workflows: upload, describe, and download finished videos—no editing software needed.
- Built-in handling for credits, exports, session management, and error responses.
- Streamlined input matching and event handling for quick edits and iterative video creation.
